info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Account Deactivation API
info.description: The Settlement Account Deactivation API allows authorized users to deactivate existing settlement accounts within the system. This endpoint is crucial for maintaining the integrity and accuracy of financial records by ensuring that inactive accounts are properly managed. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and system administrators who oversee account lifecycle management. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their settlement processes and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

delete.description: This operation allows you to permanently delete the specified settlement account identified by its unique account number. Ensure that this action is performed with caution as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the data needed to delete the specified settlement account. Ensure that the account identifier is correctly specified to avoid unintended deletion.

204.description: The resource has been successfully deleted, and there is no additional content to return.

DeleteSettlementAccountAcc200045Request.description: A string representing the request body for deleting an operation related to settlement accounts.

DeleteSettlementAccountAcc200045Response.title: Settlement Accounts Delete Response
DeleteSettlementAccountAcc200045Response.description: This schema represents the response received after a successful deletion of a settlement account.
